entries.title: Capell admin dashboard with the Welcome Tour onboarding checklist.
entries.notes: Capture from a disposable installed Capell application with Welcome Tour enabled and onboarding checklist state available for the authenticated administrator. Capture at 1440, 768 and 360px in both schemes; reject overflow, focus-order and console/network/backend errors.
entries.useCase: A first-time administrator lands on the dashboard checklist and can launch onboarding.

entries.title: Welcome tour overlay showing the first configured onboarding step.
entries.notes: Install real registered steps with available DOM targets. Prove chapter and step progress, Next, Previous, Done, Snooze and dismissal; no dashboard fallback counts. Capture at 1440, 768 and 360px in both schemes; reject overflow, focus-order and console/network/backend errors.
entries.useCase: A first-time administrator sees the first configured tour step overlay.

entries.title: Welcome Tour settings with ordinary onboarding controls and collapsed developer details.
entries.notes: Open the Welcome Tour settings action from the Extensions manager after publishing and running the package settings migration. Capture at 1440, 768 and 360px in both schemes; reject overflow, focus-order and console/network/backend errors.
entries.useCase: An owner reads eligible chapters and checklist tasks, previews as themselves, or restarts their own tour.

entries.title: User edit form with Show welcome tour toggle.
entries.notes: Use an authorised user editor with package state storage available. Prove Show welcome tour copy distinguishes eligibility from restarting progress. Capture at 1440, 768 and 360px in both schemes; reject overflow, focus-order and console/network/backend errors.
entries.useCase: An administrator toggles whether a user should see the welcome tour again from the user edit form.

entries.title: Capell admin dashboard with the Welcome Tour onboarding checklist with admin sidebar menu open.
entries.notes: Capture from a disposable installed Capell application with Welcome Tour enabled and onboarding checklist state available for the authenticated administrator. Capture this same admin surface with the fully collapsible sidebar opened.
entries.useCase: A first-time administrator lands on the dashboard checklist and can launch onboarding.

entries.title: Welcome Tour grouped developer authoring and destination validation.
entries.notes: Open Advanced developer and add an unsaved custom step. Capture Destination and the collapsed Audience, Appearance and key/order groups. Do not save this capture draft. Use requiredViewport; the runner tablet/mobile presets are 1024/390px and must be adjusted by the capture manager to 768/360px.
entries.useCase: An owner reads eligible chapters and checklist tasks, previews as themselves, or restarts their own tour.
